headline: THE THREE-TIER DEFAULT IS NOT ACCEPTED BY THIS CAMPAIGN. Two gates FAIL, two are not captured, and the two FAILs belong to different changes -- one to the far tier this campaign was convened for, one to the two-LOD promotion that preceded it.

gates.decisive: 13/13. 93,564 staged serving files re-verified; far-tier inventory cf8e2648 at its pin; 840+43=883 reconciled; six -s2 manifests real JSON; both probe markers in the served bytes; 7 frozen records byte-identical; AC power read.

Delta EXACTLY 0 over 839 tiles. H2 (trunc 4/3) = 283,290,003 = probe. H1 (no mips) short 70,822,291; H3 (exact pyramid) short exactly 839 = one byte per tile. Cesium generates mips and accounts with the truncated 4/3.
283,290,003 vs 291,984,434 bar. 3.0% headroom. Decoded GPU bytes.
378,592,995 vs 390,295,058 bar. 3.0% headroom; 3,864,889 B under the runtime v2 prediction its author called 'inside, and not comfortably'.
4/5 stations pass. overview-52km-island p50 16.8 (bar 16.7) and p95 25.2 (bar 25), n=621. Both percentiles missed; recorded FAIL, not rounded. PRE-DECLARED as possible before any capture.
about:blank control same session: p50 8.3, p95 10.0, n=1440. No station instrument-limited. Not a bar and not scored.
max doubleDrawMs 6,165.2 vs inherited 4,000 leg-Y. D-11 NOT closed in either direction. Prior: 5,746 (ADR 0045), 7,122.2 (ADR 0053).

G1 measured 263,367,077; minus 263,017,553 far-tier atlas bytes = 349,524 = 4x87,381, the four-tile prediction to the byte. G2 implies 3,245 class tiles where 24 expected. Far-tier-blind instruments, not a regression.

gates.gate: Three-tier composition below the 450 m bucket
gates.decisive: street-260m-midtown and street-260m-w02-lower carry all three tiers: massing 251/154, exterior resident 8, far tier drawn 738/811, publish-seq advancing 29/9. Counter-finding: the three overview stations and P2 are TWO-tier (massingActive 0).
Boot-doc filter pins ids ending -s1; the default now activates six -s2. Frozen baseline: six -s1 waves, 18 boot docs. Substantive half holds (6 waves, 883 cells, no exterior param).
1 of 4 panel rows vs 4 of 4 in the frozen baseline, same query and pose. NOT the far tier: farTier=off reproduces it. Cause is the -s1 to -s2 residency change.
Opt-in release active, scheduler holds 8 resident cells.
Round trip true, panel digests match.
App states unavailability in words; still differs by checksum. Rule restated for three tiers as pre-registered.
Reads an eviction record this campaign did not produce.
Separate invocation not reached before the heap phase claimed the vehicle.
Three instrument-failure aborts; no attempt reached lap 3 of 9; no record written by the instrument on any attempt. Vehicle cannot hold a ~45-minute exclusive-focus run.
P2 oblique surface mean luminance 0.3596, max 0.8700, 0.0000 massing share in region.
P3 nadir surface mean luminance 0.1564, max 0.3461; 3 dense buildings active outside the region.
First far-tier attribute 195 and 199 ms, WARM CACHE, not comparable with T005's cold 4,511-7,529 ms.
13/13 again. The 7 frozen records are byte-identical at the END of the campaign as well as the start.

whatFailedAndWhose.F1: The far tier's. The failing station is the 52 km island overview, the maximum-residency pose where the far tier holds essentially the whole island, and it misses both percentiles. Pre-declared as possible before any capture.
whatFailedAndWhose.J2: NOT the far tier's. Proven by re-running the same pose with farTier=off and reproducing the loss exactly. It belongs to the -s1 to -s2 two-LOD serving promotion changing which cells are resident at that camera.

whatWasNotMeasured: M1 heap growth: three aborts, no series.
Wave-tier GPU accounting: the committed G-series cannot express it in a three-tier scene.
Any appearance verdict: all appearance items are REPORTED.

rollback.statement: A campaign FAIL does NOT automatically flip FAR_TIER_DEFAULT_ON, as registered before any reading.
rollback.reason: false restores the pre-HLOD composition and nothing else -- the raised ceilings and swapped pin stay in the build. That is a third configuration nobody has measured. Rolling back on this evidence would trade a measured configuration with two known defects for an unmeasured one.
rollback.andJ2WouldSurvive: Decisively: J2 reproduces with farTier=off, so flipping the far tier off would NOT fix the one user-visible failure this campaign found.

t008Dispositions: F1 at the island overview: 0.1 ms and 0.2 ms over the bar at maximum far-tier residency.
J2: a searched building at the 260 m midtown pose no longer shows cell/release, active asset or truth-tier rows, because its cell is not resident under -s2.
J1 boot-document filter and the G-series byte accounting are pinned to the -s1 era and cannot express a three-tier scene.
M1 needs an instrument whose sampling does not depend on window focus, or a dedicated quiet session.
The far-tier capture harness (T005 N11) now exists; the committed acceptance harnesses remain far-tier-blind.
nonClaims: One machine, one session, AC power. No distribution, no confidence interval.
Passing gates are not visual, geographic or accessibility acceptance.
Criterion #30 is closed elsewhere and was not re-litigated; it is reported in its own units and added to nothing.
